pages.text: Every companion has $(thing)4 armor slots$(), a $(thing)main weapon$() slot, an $(thing)off-hand$() slot for a shield or second weapon, and a $(thing)15-slot backpack$().$(br2)Swords, axes, Epic Fight weapons and most modded weapons fit the weapon slots. Shift-click sends armor and weapons to the right slot.

Weapon enchantments work: $(thing)Sharpness$(), $(thing)Smite$(), $(thing)Knockback$(), $(thing)Fire Aspect$() and others. Weapons lose durability like yours and break when worn out.$(br2)Companions $(thing)pick up items$() they walk over, including what you drop for them. See the $(thing)Hand$() button.

pages.title: Auto-Equip
pages.text: Put better gear in the $(thing)backpack$() and the companion wears it on their own after a moment out of combat: armor by protection, melee weapon by damage, a shield if the off-hand is empty. The old piece goes back to the backpack.$(br2)They never swap out a bow or crossbow, and skip nearly broken items.

pages.title: If They Fall
pages.text: When a companion dies, everything they carried drops on the ground. The companion is gone for good, so keep them fed and well armored.
